items.text: Among adults on 50 mg oral morphine equivalents a day or more who enter the pharmacist-led tapering pathway between November 2026 and October 2027, what is the mean percent change in daily opioid dose and in pain interference from entry to 6 and 12 months?
items.population: Adults entering the tapering pathway at the Vellmoor pain clinic
items.outcome: Percent change in daily dose; change in pain interference

items.text: Are distance from the clinic and interpreter need associated with disengagement from the pathway within 12 months?
items.intervention: Living more than 60 km away; needing an interpreter

finer: Feasible with existing calls and 0.4 FTE; interesting to the hospital and to patients; novel locally; ethical because nothing is added to care; relevant to the 2027 funding decision.
summary: Two PECO questions: dose and pain interference over 12 months, and predictors of disengagement.
